content: Low-res WebGLRenderTarget upscaling: render scene to small target, upscale with NearestFilter magFilter to avoid halos/blur; must recreate/resize target on window resize (renderer.setSize does NOT resize manually created targets); setPixelRatio interplay doubles the internal size unexpectedly on HiDPI. Pixel-art upscaling needs integer scale factors or pixels smear unevenly.
